newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Bankers Trust in loan for Charterhouse buy.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Bankers Trust in loan for Charterhouse buy.

text.p: LONDON, Oct 10 (LPC) - Bankers Trust is arranging a 140 million stg term loan backing Charterhouse Development Capital's 380 million stg acquisition of Inchcape Testing Services from motors and distribution group Inchcape, said Stuart Simpson, a director of Charterhouse.
The loan has a maturity of 7 or 8 years, Simpson said, and is priced at 200 bps over LIBOR. General syndication is expected in November.

In addition to the bank debt, Charterhouse is financing the deal through a planned 120 million stg high-yield US bond issue with a fixed rate of 11 percent. This is said to be the first time a UK venture capital deal has funded through the bond markets.
Equity for the deal consists of 90 million stg from Charterhouse and 50 million stg from Bankers Trust.
Syndication of the bank deal is in part dependent on the success of the bond issue, Simpson said.
